evidence_candidates.excerpt: SK hynix reported that its HBM4 design uses 2,048 I/O terminals, operates above 10 Gbit/s per pin, and improves power efficiency by more than 40 percent relative to the previous generation.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: SK hynix reported in September 2025 that its HBM4 product was prepared for mass production with 2,048 I/O terminals, over 10 Gbit/s pin speed, and more than 40 percent better power efficiency than its previous generation.
